title: Plasma balls turning into solid objects in UFO legacy program testimonies

tellings.quote: And when you see testimonies of, you know, people in the quote unquote UFO legacy program and these plasma balls seem to kind of cohhere and become inert and turn into these solid objects and then come out of the sky once they're summoned

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that people who claim to have worked in a secret government effort, which he calls the UFO legacy program, describe balls of glowing plasma that seem to pull together, go still and turn into solid objects. He says these objects then come down out of the sky once they are summoned. If true, it would mean these craft can be called down on purpose.
